edges.reason: transfer() delegates to internal _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer to perform the actual accounting.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam with the team tax amount.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with the reflection fee.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute amounts.
_getValues calls _getRate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply.
_takeTeam calls _getRate to convert tokens to reflections.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with address(this).balance.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth mid-transfer when swapEnabled and sender is not the pair.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract ETH balance exceeds the threshold.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call with amountOutMin = 0.
sendETHToFee performs a raw ETH transfer to _feeWallet.
addLiquidity performs an external payable addLiquidityETH call.
addLiquidity reads the contract token amount via balanceOf -> tokenFromReflection.
msg.sender becomes the from address in _transfer via _msgSender().
_owner is initialized from constructor msg.sender, granting onlyOwner privileges.
_feeWallet is set to payable(_msgSender()) in the constructor, controlling fee payout destination.
manualswap is external with no onlyOwner guard, so any msg.sender can trigger the swap.
manualsend is external with no onlyOwner guard, so any msg.sender can drain the contract ETH balance.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline (timestamp dependency).
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline (timestamp dependency).
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount to bound buy amounts.
increaseMaxTxPercentage recomputes _maxTxAmount using mul/div on owner-supplied percentage.
setBots writes the bots blacklist mapping.
enableTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
addToSwap stores the router address in uniswapV2Router.
addToSwap creates and stores the Uniswap pair in uniswapV2Pair.
addLiquidity sets swapEnabled to true.
lockTheSwap toggles inSwap around the router swap.
_transfer computes and stores contractTokenBalance.
_transfer computes and stores contractETHBalance.
contractTokenBalance is passed into swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance gates the call to sendETHToFee.
tokenAmount flows into the router swap call.
amount flows into the ETH transfer to _feeWallet.
percentage determines the new _maxTxAmount value.
rAmount is divided by the current rate inside tokenFromReflection.
_takeTeam caches _getRate() in the currentRate local.
_transferStandard mutates _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_takeTeam credits _rOwned of the contract address.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by the token fee.
_approve writes _allowances.
Constructor sets _owner, the privilege root for onlyOwner functions.
from is the sender parameter declared by _transfer.
to is the recipient parameter declared by _transfer.
amount is the transfer amount parameter declared by _transfer.
tokenAmount is the value parameter declared by swapTokensForEth.
amount is the value parameter declared by sendETHToFee.
percentage is the value parameter declared by increaseMaxTxPercentage.
rAmount is the value parameter declared by tokenFromReflection.
bots_ is the array parameter declared by setBots.
isBot is the flag parameter declared by setBots.
tAmount is the value parameter declared by _transferStandard.
The ETH transfer in sendETHToFee can execute code in a malicious _feeWallet that re-enters the unguarded manualsend/manualswap entry points.
The external router swap can call back into the token before all swap-related state settles.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to feed _transfer's address checks and mapping updates.
The to parameter only exists to feed _transfer's address checks and mapping updates.
The amount parameter is only consumed by _transfer's limit checks and accounting.
contractTokenBalance is a transient local consumed directly by swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is a transient local whose threshold check drives sendETHToFee.
tokenAmount is forwarded verbatim into the router swap unsafe operation.
amount is forwarded verbatim into the ETH transfer unsafe operation.
percentage is only meaningful as the input of increaseMaxTxPercentage.
rAmount is only used inside tokenFromReflection's rate division.
currentRate is a transient local computed inside _takeTeam.
bots_ is only iterated by setBots.
isBot is only written into the bots mapping by setBots.
tAmount is only consumed by _transferStandard's amount computation.
